failure_case.summary: Stress test: fog + one runway closed + low fuel + gate zone closed: zero legal candidates for DL1126
failure_case.what_happened: The rule layer blocked all 5 candidate slots (CAP-01 2, FUEL-01 2, WAKE-01 1). No agent was asked; the system reported 'no safe plan, consider diversion' and handed over to the duty manager.
failure_case.why: Acceptance dropped to 1 arrival per 10 min, and every candidate slot hit a hard rule: #1 18:15: 18:10-18:20 already has 2 arrivals, fog + one closed runway limit is 1; #2 18:21: preceding EV5008 is Heavy, gap 0 min < 3; #3 18:27: 18:20-18:30 already has 2 arrivals, fog + one closed runway limit is 1; ...
failure_case.fix: Add later slots and diversion airports as candidates, so the desks can negotiate a longer hold or a diversion instead of giving up.
